title: MPESB ITI Training Officer Result 2026 – Out
vacancyDetails: 1120 ITI Training Officer posts across various trades/districts in Madhya Pradesh
qualification: As per trade – ITI / Diploma / Degree with relevant trade qualification and eligibility in MPESB notification
ageLimit: As per MPESB ITI Training Officer 2026 advertisement
applicationFee: As per MPESB online fee structure
selectionProcess: Written Exam (First Phase) → Further stages as per board (document verification / skill as applicable)
documentsRequired: Application No., DOB, Mother name initials + Aadhaar last 4 digits for score login; educational & trade certificates
howToApply:
1. Visit https://esb.mp.gov.in
2. Open Results → ITI Training Officer Recruitment Test – 2026
3. Enter Application No., Date of Birth and security fields
4. Download scorecard / check merit
5. Also download Result Note, Cut-off and Seat Matrix PDFs from the result page
shortDescription: MPESB has declared First Phase Result for ITI Training Officer 2026 (1120 posts). Check scorecard and cut-off on esb.mp.gov.in (declared 24 July 2026).
content:
The Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB / ESB) has released the ITI Training Officer Recruitment Test – 2026 First Phase Result on 24 July 2026.

The exam was held on 27 February 2026 for 1,120 Training Officer vacancies in ITIs under various trades.

Available on official site

  • Individual result / marks login
  • Result Note PDF
  • Cut-off PDF
  • Top 10 list
  • Updated Seat Matrix

Login needs Application Number, Date of Birth and first 2 letters of mother’s name + last 4 digits of Aadhaar. Portal: esb.mp.gov.in.
